name: Anointing With Oil
overview: Scripture reveals that anointing with oil is a sacred practice used to consecrate persons and objects for holy purposes, as seen when Aaron and the tabernacle were anointed to sanctify them (Exodus 29:7; 40:9; Leviticus 8:12). This act signifies God's setting apart and blessing, exemplified by the anointing of the Messiah with the 'oil of gladness' (Psalms 45:7). Additionally, anointing with oil was practiced in personal devotion and ministry, such as during fasting (Matthew 6:17) and for healing the sick (Mark 6:13), underscoring its spiritual and restorative significance in the life of believers.
